label: KakaoTalk
terms_note: Kakao Talk Message API (developers.kakao.com): 'Send to me' needs no permission (unlimited to the user's own chatroom); 'Send to friends' needs the Send Kakao Talk Message scope + friends-list consent AND conversion to a business app; before approval 30 messages / day for testing, after approval up to 30,000 / day per app with 100 messages sent / received per user and 20 exchanges per sender-recipient pair; templates = default (feed, list, location, commerce, text, calendar), custom (message template tool) and scrape. The docs explicitly separate this from Kakao Talk Channel messaging (Brand Message, Info Talk / AlimTalk, CS Talk) 'which operate through the Kakao Business platform'. Kakao Talk Channel API on developers.kakao.com only adds a channel / checks relationship / manages customer files (needs a Business Channel + Biz App, 3-5 business-day review); targeted messages are sent in the Channel Manager Center, not via API.

sdks: Kakao SDK (Android / iOS / JavaScript) + REST — developers.kakao.com

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **partial**. What exists publicly (developers.kakao.com) is the **Kakao Talk Message API** — a

Kakao Talk Channel API: `followChannel()` / `addChannel()` (SDK), relationship check, customer-file upload for Channel Manager Center targeting

reference.limits: - The docs "explicitly distinguish this API from KakaoTalk Channel messaging (Brand Message, Info Talk, CS Talk), which operate through Kakao Business platform separately" — those are service-to-user, template-approved, sent via dealers. - No inbound API for user replies (messages land in the sender's KakaoTalk); no webhooks.

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: REST API key of the Kakao app ([App] > [Platform Key] > [REST API key]), sent as client_id to POST https://kauth.kakao.com/oauth/token (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/kakaologin/rest-api).

fields.name: client_secret
fields.help: Client secret of the REST API key; 'Required when the setting is [ON]' (enabled by default for new keys).

fields.name: refresh_token
fields.help: Refresh token from Kakao Login (authorization code flow) of the SENDING user, with consent to the talk_message scope and friends-list access (friends scope); valid about 60 days (refresh_token_expires_in 5184000). Kakao returns a renewed refresh_token when less than a month is left: the runtime keeps it in memory and, with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set, saves it to <dir>/kakao.json (mode 0600).

config_fields.name: link_url
config_fields.help: Web URL opened when the message is tapped (text template link.web_url / mobile_web_url, 'O' required); its domain must be registered as a Web domain under Product Link on the app management page (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/message-template/default).

adapter.terms: Kakao Talk Message API is user-to-user: 'Send to friends' reaches only friends who also consented to the app (receiver uuids from the friends API), needs the Send Kakao Talk Message permission and a business app for production volume, and has daily quotas; Kakao Talk Channel business messages (AlimTalk / Brand Message) are a separate Kakao Business product.

me.note: GET /v2/user/me returns the token's user {id, connected_at, properties, kakao_account}.

send.note: SENDS a Kakao Talk message as the token's user to ONE app-connected friend: `to` is the friend's uuid (from the friends API / Friends picker, not a phone number or user id). Form fields receiver_uuids=["<to>"] and template_object = default text template {object_type: 'text', text (max 200 characters displayed), link (config link_url)}; `subject` and `channel` are ignored. Success answers {successful_receiver_uuids}; a single-recipient failure is an HTTP error with Kakao's code and msg. Counts against the app's daily message quota. No message id is returned.

not_offered.list_inbound: The Kakao Talk Message API only sends ('Send to me' / 'Send to friends', https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/kakaotalk-message/rest-api); there is no endpoint to read received messages.
not_offered.get_thread: No conversation or history endpoint exists in the Kakao Talk Message API (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/kakaotalk-message/rest-api).
not_offered.reply: Messages have no thread ids to reply to; use send to the friend's uuid (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/kakaotalk-message/rest-api).
not_offered.mark_read: The Kakao Talk Message API has no read-state endpoint (https://developers.kakao.com/docs/en/kakaotalk-message/rest-api).

evidence: host kapi.kakao.com: DNS ok, TLSv1.3 (DigiCert Inc)
probe: 2/2 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
HTML docs spot-check (render-doc): 1/1 tool paths found verbatim on their docs pages; every parameter and body key named on the page
